name: Zofia Kowalczyk
bio:
Zofia's path to motorsport HR was unconventional. After graduating with a degree in organizational psychology, she spent several years in the corporate world, becoming disillusioned with the rigid structures and lack of passion. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, attending Polish Rally Championship events as a child, she decided to combine her professional skills with her personal interests. She took a significant pay cut to join a small racing team, proving her worth through dedication and an ability to navigate complex interpersonal dynamics within the high-pressure environment of the paddock.

Now at Garage 59, Zofia focuses on building a supportive and efficient work environment. She believes in fostering open communication and encouraging team members to develop their skills. Her calm demeanor and ability to mediate conflicts effectively make her a valuable asset. She's known for her sharp eye for talent and her commitment to ensuring fair treatment for all team members, even when facing tight deadlines and demanding personalities. Zofia's goal is to make Garage 59 a place where individuals can thrive and contribute their best.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A slender woman with a warm smile and perpetually tired eyes from long hours.
